hooks.command:
if command -v comment-checker >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec comment-checker
elif command -v direnv >/dev/null 2>&1; then exec direnv exec "${PWD:-.}" comment-checker
elif [ -f flake.nix ]; then echo "This project has flake.nix. Run direnv allow or nix develop so comment-checker is on PATH (the flake wraps it in bwrap)." >&2; echo "comment-checker did not run — nothing checked this write." >&2; exit 1
else echo "Install it: pnpm add -g @systemfsoftware/claude-code-comment-checker" >&2; echo "comment-checker did not run — nothing checked this write." >&2; exit 1
fi
